description: crl.rs line 48 and ocsp.rs line 51: both ::new constructors take Vec<u8> for the DER bytes parameter. Callers who have a &[u8] or a fixed-size array must allocate before calling. Accepting impl Into<Vec<u8>> would allow passing &[u8], Box<[u8]>, or Vec<u8> without a separate allocation at the call site. This is a minor ergonomics issue.
title: CrlChecker::new and OcspChecker::new take Vec<u8> instead of impl Into<Vec<u8>>
